def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in g for x in row),
             key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in g))

    seen = set()
    blocks, singles = [], []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x, g[y][x]))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                        (yy, xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx] != bg):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            if len(cells) == 1:
                singles.append(cells[0])
            else:
                ys = [p[0] for p in cells]
                xs = [p[1] for p in cells]
                blocks.append((min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs), cells[0][2]))

    blocks.sort(key=lambda b: b[2])
    bh = blocks[0][1] - blocks[0][0] + 1
    by = blocks[0][0]
    starts = [b[2] for b in blocks]
    widths = [b[3] - b[2] + 1 for b in blocks]
    gap = blocks[1][2] - blocks[0][3] - 1
    vstep = bh + gap
    template_colors = [b[4] for b in blocks]

    key_rows = sorted(set(r for r, c, color in singles))
    key_cols = sorted(set(c for r, c, color in singles))
    keys = [[bg] * len(key_cols) for _ in key_rows]
    for r, c, color in singles:
        keys[key_rows.index(r)][key_cols.index(c)] = color

    template_index = next(i for i, row in enumerate(keys)
                          if [x for x in row if x != bg] == template_colors)

    for i, row in enumerate(keys):
        top = by + (i - template_index) * vstep
        for j, color in enumerate(row):
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for y in range(top, top + bh):
                for x in range(starts[j], starts[j] + widths[j]):
                    if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                        g[y][x] = color
    return g
